deadline.value: No Fall 2027 deadline appears on the fetched CEAS pages; the CEAS FAQ's January 15 priority date is for Fall 2026.

funding.value: All full-time PhD students receive an assistantship and full tuition scholarship in their first year; later support is not guaranteed on the page.
funding.quote: All full-time PhD students are offer an assistantship and a full tuition GIA for their first year of study.

entry_route.value: The page does not state whether a master's is required.

supervisor.value: The page does not state a supervisor rule.

app_fee.value: Engineering (CEAS) charges international applicants $80, $5 above the standard international fee.
app_fee.quote: $80.00 for international applicants to the College of Engineering & Applied Science (CEAS)

fee_waiver.value: CEAS does not offer application fee waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: CEAS does not offer application fee waivers.

toefl_min.value: Engineering (CEAS) asks for TOEFL iBT 92; the CEAS FAQ also accepts a 4.5 new-scale minimum from January 2026.
toefl_min.quote: International students - English Proficiency Test: TOEFL (minimum 92) or IELTS (minimum 6.5)

ielts_min.value: Engineering (CEAS) asks for an IELTS overall band of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: International students - English Proficiency Test: TOEFL (minimum 92) or IELTS (minimum 6.5)

gre_general.value: GRE is required for this PhD, except for US ABET-accredited graduates with a GPA of 3.0 or higher.
gre_general.quote: GRE is required for the below programs, with the exception of any student that receives their bachelor's (BS) degree from an ABET accredited university in the United States with a GPA of 3.0+. | Computer Science and Engineering – PhD

gre_subject.value: The page does not mention a GRE Subject test for this field.
